name: Windows Services (Persistence)
purpose: Services configured with Start=2 (auto) or 3 (demand) launch at boot or on demand, commonly abused for SYSTEM-level persistence.
normal_baseline: Services correspond to installed hardware drivers and legitimate software.
anomalies: ImagePath pointing to a non-standard directory
svchost-hosted service with an unrecognized ServiceDll
Service created shortly before/after other IOC timestamps
anti_forensic_notes: Services can be created/deleted quickly with sc.exe; correlate with Security event 4697/7045 (System log) for creation evidence when auditing is enabled.
